summary: Imperial Steam is a tight economic pick-up-and-deliver game where you hire workers, lay track, staff factories, and fulfill contracts before the connection to Trieste triggers sudden-death scoring. It's a spiritual successor to the Age of Steam/Indonesia lineage, rewarding efficient engine-building and route timing over direct confrontation.
praised: meaningful decisions on nearly every action
strong sense of progression as the map fills up
criticised: notable downtime at higher player counts
punishing for players who mismanage cash flow early

interaction.detail: All players build factories and rail links onto one shared map, so track and city connections can be contested or blocked outright. Goods sold into a common market and public contracts fulfilled on a first-come basis mean players are constantly racing each other for the same deliveries, but without any direct action against an opponent's pieces.

scoring.how_you_win: The game ends the moment a player's rail connects to Trieste; everyone then totals net worth (cash plus the value of factories, track and completed contracts, minus debt), and the richest player wins.
